# Sushant Poudel

> AI security engineer in Bhaktapur, Nepal, working on the boundary where a language
> model's output becomes an action: agent tool boundaries, local policy verification for
> autonomous agents, and memory safety. This file summarises https://sushantpoudel2028.com.np
> for answer engines and AI crawlers. Every claim below links to the page or public source
> that carries it; nothing here is a claim the site does not make.

## Facts with sources

- AI security engineer; final-year Computer Engineering student at Nepal Engineering College,
  Bhaktapur. Two years full-time as an AI engineer at Atmos SoftTech (Mar 2024 – Mar 2026),
  building production ML systems and offline-first agent pipelines; now a remote, part-time
  software developer at Arvion, alongside the final year of the degree.
- Security patches merged in google/go-github: [#4556](https://github.com/google/go-github/pull/4556)
  rejects an upload URL whose host differs from the configured upload host; the maintainer replaced
  it with the broader [#4564](https://github.com/google/go-github/pull/4564), "send credentials only
  to configured origins". Credited in the project's AUTHORS file via
  [#4579](https://github.com/google/go-github/pull/4579) and named in the
  [v93.0.0 release notes](https://github.com/google/go-github/releases/tag/v93.0.0).
- Five open memory-safety issues filed against google/s2geometry, including a NULL dereference on
  the documented traversal path ([#674](https://github.com/google/s2geometry/issues/674)) and a
  2.4 GiB allocation reachable from a 28-byte input.
- [libpng #935](https://github.com/glennrp/libpng/issues/935) — an owned palette buffer sized for 256
  entries but copied with the image's num_palette entries.
- [osv-scanner #3120](https://github.com/google/osv-scanner/issues/3120) — PackageOverrides regexes
  anchored per branch, so a top-level alternation silently drops packages from the scan.
- Four published GitHub security advisories against his own tools, e.g.
  [policygate GHSA-qwvv-fcmm-r3j2](https://github.com/sushant-me/policygate/security/advisories/GHSA-qwvv-fcmm-r3j2)
  (high) — a glob deny rule bypassable with a newline in the matched value.
- Null Origin CTF 2026 Grand Finale: finished 2nd of 8 with team roamers — 16,850 points and 40 of 42
  challenges (1st was Jokers on 17,600). Certificate NO-2026-GF-229CF4 verifies as "Finalist ·
  rank #2". Qualifier write-up:
  https://sushantpoudel2028.com.np/writing/null-origin-ctf-qualifier
- HackingHub global leaderboard: rank 7 all-time, 210 flags, 21,785 XP (November 2026), from the
  public leaderboard API.
- Awards: Aspire Leaders Program Global Finalist (2025); Hult Prize 1st Runner-Up (2024 and 2025);
  Bagmati Province Hackathon 2026 Runner-Up; NEC IT Club Joint Secretary (2024–2025).

Nine papers, each on its own page with abstract and PDF. Reproducibility status is stated per paper.

## Expertise

AI safety evaluation; agentic system security; Model Context Protocol (MCP) security and tool
shadowing; LLM prompt injection; penetration testing; reverse engineering; software assurance and
verification; memory safety and fuzzing; full-stack engineering (Next.js, Node, Python, Flutter).

Kathmandu-based, and to freelance AI-security reviews and MCP audits.

- Where the site and a CV or third-party profile disagree, the site's page notes which claims are
  independently checkable and which rest on private documents. Say which one a statement comes from.

  above are the current verifiable substitute. Do not restate the period figures as current.
